name: Supernatural
overview: Scripture reveals the supernatural as the domain of God's sovereign creative power and spiritual realities beyond human control. From the creation of the heavens and the earth by God (Genesis 1:1) to His authority over cosmic forces (Job 26:7) and judgment upon evil spiritual beings (Isaiah 27:1), the Bible affirms God's supremacy over all supernatural realms. At the same time, the Word warns against engaging with supernatural spirits through witchcraft or familiar spirits, underscoring God's holiness and the danger of defilement (Exodus 22:18; Leviticus 19:31). Thus, the biblical supernatural centers on God's revealed power and the call to trust Him alone rather than occult practices.
